definitions.explanation: The large sea bordered by southern Europe, North Africa, and western Asia. Also used adjectivally to describe the culture, climate, and cuisine of the surrounding region.

examples.japanese: {地中海|ちちゅうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{面|めん}した→面する：14629_mensuru⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧。
examples.english: A country facing the Mediterranean Sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{地中海|ちちゅうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リゾート→リゾート：11394_rizooto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
Literally "sea in the middle of the land," from {地|ち} (land) + ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (middle) + {海|かい} (sea) — a calque of the Latin Mare Mediterraneum.

USAGE:
Beyond the geographical reference, {地中海|ちちゅうかい} is commonly used as a modifier for the region's culture, climate, cuisine, and style: {地中海|ちちゅうかい}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (Mediterranean cuisine), {地中海|ちちゅうかい}⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧ (Mediterranean climate), {地中海|ちちゅうかい}{風|ふう} (Mediterranean-style).
